name: TC Kimlik Numarası
notes: NVİ states the number has 11 digits and that the last two are check digits calculated from the first nine; the formula is shared with public institutions but is not published on the NVİ website. This dataset does not redistribute an unpublished algorithm.

name: Vergi Kimlik Numarası
notes: UBL-TR / e-Fatura PartyIdentification treats VKN as a 10-digit schemeID value (schematron length checks). GİB does not publish a public check-digit algorithm for VKN; this dataset records only the format constraints that can be cited from official material.
